args.reason: Add the Clipper Embedded Python block writing to clipped.dat.

args.command: python3 -c "import numpy as np; x=np.fromfile('clipped.dat',dtype=np.float32)[4800:]; print(len(x), float(x.mean()), float(x.min()), float(x.max()), float(np.sqrt(np.mean(x*x))))"

final_text: I added an Embedded Python block after the tone that limits it to -0.3 .. 0.3, and a File Sink writing it to clipped.dat. A run gives a maximum of 0.3, a minimum of -0.3 and an RMS of about 0.257 for the 0.5 tone. I saved the block to the library as clipper (label Clipper) and saved the flowgraph. mirrored.dat and second_quantized.dat are unchanged.
